gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Tourney cuts every letter from one unbroken line width, then stretches the words out with wide tracking and bulky small letters. Noto Sans Medefaidrin follows in sans-serif, tall in the lowercase.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Loud, stretched, built like a scoreboard. Tourney keeps its stroke width constant, and Noto Sans Meetei Mayek brings large lowercase eyes and rounds that gap like a cracked bangle.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikakui: Noto Sans Mende Kikakui lets daylight through every curved opening, and its lowercase stands tall against the capitals. Tourney draws like a plotter pen, wide and bulky, so they share a page easily.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Tourney builds its letters from rods rather than carved blades, then spreads them with wide tracking and bulky small forms. Noto Sans Meroitic, in sans-serif, fills the line with see-through c openings.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-modi: Tourney keeps its stems and arcs in lockstep, with wide tracking and oversized small letters adding an athletic punch. Noto Sans Modi holds the quietest, most open quality in the pair, with daylight in every curve.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-mono: Tourney is all bold, athletic stretch, with no calligraphic thinning anywhere in its wide-tracked letters. Noto Sans Mono gives it room to breathe, a plain sans with sturdy, generously spaced lowercase.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro packs its words dense and tall through the middle, with wide entrances into each letter's inner space. Tourney, pipe-cleaner thin in stroke and stretched wide, shouts best while this one reads best.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-multani: Athletic and bold, Tourney stretches its words wide, with no hairline-to-stem shift anywhere. And Noto Sans Multani sits beneath in a sans with a lofty x-height and an e that opens wide.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Bold energy runs through Tourney, whose crossbars are as fat as the stems they connect and whose words stretch wide with tracking. Noto Sans Myanmar feels heavier and steadier beside it.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Noto Sans Nabataean stands its lowercase almost cap-tall, with wide-open s curves. Tourney excels at stretched, bulky, round-tipped-pen shapes, but the body font does the quiet reading.
